aoi: east-94-559-c74 (Phase 22L/22N TRAIN development AOI; full-footprint guard passed in 22N)
interpretation: SAR co-change is multi-sensor corroboration of UNKNOWN candidates, not validation

rules.background: Phase 22L eligible cells with valid SAR in both seasons, excluding candidate cells
rules.caveat: cells are spatially autocorrelated; permutation p-values are descriptive, not confirmatory
rules.change: dVV = after_VV - before_VV, dVH = after_VH - before_VH (dB)
rules.cluster_level: six 8-connected cluster means vs 10,000 random draws of six background cells (seed 43)
rules.co_change: candidate cell with dVH or dVV outside the background 5th-95th percentile range
rules.permutation: 10,000 random draws of n_candidate cells from the SAR-valid eligible pool, seed 42; p = (1 + #|null| >= |obs|) / (1 + draws)
rules.reproduction_gate: on cells shared with Phase 6B tile east-94-559, |dVV|,|dVH| differences <= 0.01 dB else STOP
rules.sar: Phase 2 sar.seasonal: S1 GRD IW 10 m, DESCENDING, relative orbit 77 (as Phase 6B), linear-power 20 m circular focal mean, seasonal median in dB, >=2 observations per season
